_about: Engine policy, read by the launcher and by the server as it starts: which engines may run, which one the launcher starts, and how a run on an alpha or beta engine is acknowledged (docs/design/engine-governance.md). Each engine's version, kind and release channel come from the build, not from this file.

_help.selected: Engine (Engine). Which engine builds and runs each world. core-legacy is the engine DSTNS has always used; core-ng is its next-generation replacement, built beside it, which gives the same world for the same seed and can also limit worlds to chosen countries or cities. Accepts: "core-legacy" (core-legacy), "core-ng" (core-ng (next generation)). Default: "core-legacy".
_help.auto_switch: When a run is rejected (Engine). What the observer offers when a person rejects the risk of an alpha or beta engine: to start the same seed (only the seed) on an enabled stable engine, or only to stop. Accepts: "offer" (Offer a stable engine), "off" (Only stop). Default: "offer".
_help.engines.core-ng.enabled: core-ng available (Engine). Off, core-ng stays installed but nothing can start a run on it. Accepts: true or false. Default: true.
_help.engines.core-ng.acknowledgment.enforce: core-ng: hold runs until acknowledged (Engine). core-ng is alpha. On, every run on it waits until a person accepts the risk, and the server defers anything that would run it (for applications and the API too). Off removes that protection: runs start at once, and the observer asks nothing. Accepts: true or false. Default: true.
_help.engines.core-ng.acknowledgment.ui: core-ng: acknowledge in the observer (Engine). On, the observer asks a person to accept or reject. Off while runs are still held, the launcher asks instead: start with --accept-risk. Turning holding off turns this off. Accepts: true or false. Default: true.
_help.engines.core-legacy.enabled: core-legacy available (Engine). core-legacy is the default engine, so it cannot be turned off. Accepts: true or false. Default: true.
